killedBy: createRouteHost: the diagnostics trampoline (issue #247) will not let a detached session answer for the one that replaced it
why: Drops the `current()` guard from the one member that reports a session's identity. A slot handle held past its own detach can then overwrite the live session's diagnostics, and the report names a seed from a world that no longer exists -- which reads as correct, because a seed is a number and nothing about it looks stale. Every member beside this one carries the same guard for the same reason; this is the entry that proves it was not omitted here.
